card.name: Digits inside dates and numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the second or later digit of a number, mostly the day in a written date such as '30 Oct 2012' or 'January 11'. It also fires on digits inside other numbers, such as counts, percentages and thousands.

modes.label: Day of month in dates
modes.description: The digit of a day number in a written date, often followed by a month name and year.

modes.label: Digits in other numbers
modes.description: A digit within a count, percentage, measurement or table value.
